description: Register a device in the database with adapter config and capabilities. Part of Step 3 in the onboarding flow. Required: kernelId, deviceId, type and adapterType (400 missing_required_fields otherwise).

adapterType.description: One of octoprint, modbus, opcua, sila, ipp, generic-http or mock; the route refuses anything else (including opentrons)

deviceId.description: Your ID for this device, unique within the kernel

kernelId.description: Kernel ID to register the device under

model.description: Device model identifier (optional; stored as "unknown" if absent)

type.description: Device role: machine, sensor or camera (the values setup_generate_config and setup_validate accept)

name: setup_register_device
